No frozen OHLCV files, download timestamps, or hashes are released.

Chronological dates are printed for each dataset.
10-day and selected 30-day horizons are printed.

Daily OHLCV fields are named.
Top-50/drop-5, open execution, and costs are described without a complete runner.
gpt-oss-120b is the default local model.

The realized candidates, parents, children, elites, and failures are not released.
No judgments, repairs, unit-test reports, or leakage-test traces are released.
